scope: Selected connection contracts, not an exhaustive foreign-key catalog. Owner schemas and manifests remain authoritative. Structural checks do not certify runtime semantics.

technology_effects.namespace: faction / variant / technology / effect; target_type selects namespace

magic_characters.namespace: agent_subtypes.key; paths point to derived index and skill owner

battle_maps.namespace: battle map database key / asset selector

connections.cardinality: One character has many conditional skill/rank effects; an effect can have many typed bindings.
connections.conditions: Filter record_type=effect; preserve subtype, node set, rank, effect_scope, value and binding bonus_value_id. Other binding families use their own owner schema. Never add successive ranks or treat group cost modifiers as grants.
connections.missing_boundary: Item/trait/script acquisition, build legality and runtime stacking remain incomplete. A missing indexed route does not establish inability to cast.
connections.snapshot_requirements: Pin CTW-data commit and the referenced owner manifests. Base 9.0; shared 9.0.1 joins require data/magic/input_lock.json and shared_source_comparison.json. Do not join by patch label alone.

connections.cardinality: Many contextual technology effect occurrences to zero or many native bindings.
connections.conditions: Choose faction and variant_key, filter record_type=effect, retain effect_scope and value. A native binding is candidate target evidence, not acquired research or active modifier.
connections.missing_boundary: No complete technology-to-effective-stat resolver. Non-ability effects require other bindings; absent binding means unresolved coverage, not no effect.
connections.example: Filter the selected technology file to effect rows; left-match effect_key to ability_bindings.effect and retain unmatched effects explicitly. Expand every match; keep other native binding families separate.
connections.snapshot_requirements: Pin CTW-data commit and the referenced owner manifests. Base 9.0; shared 9.0.1 joins require data/magic/input_lock.json and shared_source_comparison.json. Do not join by patch label alone.

connections.cardinality: A main-unit key occurs in multiple rosters; one unit has multiple components/weapon slots; one projectile has an optional primary explosion plus secondary graph edges.
connections.conditions: Resolve unit_key before joining; avoid multiplying attacks by duplicate roster rows. Preserve component_role, slot and ammunition_pool. Inline default-projectile columns are a projection, not a second weapon. The example covers the primary chain, not exhaustive payload closure.
connections.missing_boundary: Firing arcs, animation/cycle nesting, collision and crew targetability are not all established. Shared graph expansion must retain branch edges and cycles.
connections.example: Select one exact unit_key; retain every weapon_links row. Left-join nonblank projectile_key, then explosion_key. Distinguish a blank optional reference from a nonblank unresolved reference; never infer damage per second from reload alone.
connections.snapshot_requirements: Pin CTW-data commit and the referenced owner manifests. Base 9.0; shared 9.0.1 joins require data/magic/input_lock.json and shared_source_comparison.json. Do not join by patch label alone.

connections.cardinality: One unit has many culture-qualified abilities; an ability has multiple ordered recipient-qualified phase links.
connections.conditions: Keep (unit_key, ability_key, culture_key); * is literal wildcard. Phase identity includes order and all recipient flags, not only ability/phase. Retain requires_effect_enabling.
connections.missing_boundary: A link is not proof that its condition is active; runtime timing, stacking and activation remain qualified.
connections.example: Filter unit_ability_links by exact unit_key and preserve all cultures. Join ability_key=key; expand phases retaining order/target_self/target_friends/target_enemies. Return missing definitions explicitly.
connections.snapshot_requirements: Pin CTW-data commit and the referenced owner manifests. Base 9.0; shared 9.0.1 joins require data/magic/input_lock.json and shared_source_comparison.json. Do not join by patch label alone.

connections.cardinality: Many main-unit/roster identities can reference one land-unit identity.
connections.conditions: source_land_unit_key is a land_units key; unit_key is a main_units key. Multiple forms and roster appearances are not aliases by default.
connections.missing_boundary: No campaign availability or mount unlock follows from this mapping. Source-only summoned land units may lack a normalized roster match.
connections.example: Filter source_land_unit_key in the selected normalized roster(s), return every distinct unit_key and its roster context. Never equate a summon land-unit key with unit_key.
connections.snapshot_requirements: Pin CTW-data commit and the referenced owner manifests. Base 9.0; shared 9.0.1 joins require data/magic/input_lock.json and shared_source_comparison.json. Do not join by patch label alone.

connections.cardinality: Proposed capability routes are many-to-many with AND/OR gates; no complete normalized route layer exists.
connections.conditions: Economy owns building_levels identities; technologies own variant-specific unlock/reward conditions; units own roster permissions. target_type determines target namespace.
connections.missing_boundary: Ordinary/special recruitment, stock, capacities and propagation are not a complete production graph. Do not substitute multiplayer cost, tier or roster inclusion for recruitment legality.
connections.example: Use existing building and technology records as evidence for a requested route, then return status=unresolved for the missing recruitment edge. Do not join building_key directly to unit_key.
connections.snapshot_requirements: Pin CTW-data commit and the referenced owner manifests. Base 9.0; shared 9.0.1 joins require data/magic/input_lock.json and shared_source_comparison.json. Do not join by patch label alone.

connections.cardinality: Rule to zero/many qualified group-map rows; map identity is not a unique playable layout.
connections.conditions: Use full (battle_group_key,battle_map_key,catchment_name,tile_upgrades) relation identity with null-safe uniqueness. rule_id is snapshot-local. Asset prefixes return candidates only.
connections.missing_boundary: Campaign-coordinate catchment resolution (#29) and effective world geometry (#9/#37) are separate gaps. Cold Mires is a development hypothesis, not a production spatial owner.
connections.example: SELECT r.rule_id, r.battle_group_key, g.battle_map_key, g.catchment_name, g.tile_upgrades FROM battle_selection_rules r LEFT JOIN battle_group_maps g ON g.battle_group_key=r.battle_group_key WHERE r.rule_id=1;
connections.snapshot_requirements: Pin CTW-data commit and the referenced owner manifests. Base 9.0; shared 9.0.1 joins require data/magic/input_lock.json and shared_source_comparison.json. Do not join by patch label alone.

connections.cardinality: One primary army per faction; zero/one override for the exact ordered faction/partner pair. Other generals remain separate.
connections.conditions: Filter is_primary=1 and partner_key to the actual second human faction. Apply the entire override location as a tuple, even when start_region_key is null. Capitals remain separately labeled.
connections.missing_boundary: Static startup source evaluation, not measured movement, runtime multiplayer verification or ownership of nearest land. Snapshot-local character IDs do not persist across rebuilds.
connections.example: SELECT a.faction_key, CASE WHEN o.faction_key IS NOT NULL THEN o.world_x ELSE a.world_x END AS world_x, CASE WHEN o.faction_key IS NOT NULL THEN o.world_y ELSE a.world_y END AS world_y, CASE WHEN o.faction_key IS NOT NULL THEN o.start_region_key ELSE a.start_region_key END AS start_region_key FROM faction_army_start_reference a LEFT JOIN campaign_start_partner_overrides o ON o.faction_key=a.faction_key AND o.partner_key=:partner_key WHERE a.is_primary=1 AND a.faction_key=:faction_key;
connections.snapshot_requirements: Pin CTW-data commit and the referenced owner manifests. Base 9.0; shared 9.0.1 joins require data/magic/input_lock.json and shared_source_comparison.json. Do not join by patch label alone.

capability_routes.boundary: A separate capability/recruitment relation owner is proposed; no production path or complete graph is assigned. Reuse economy, technology, skill and unit identities without overloading economy CSVs.
